Spark conversations about faith and history 📜

Whether you're decorating a study, preparing for Reformation Day, or searching for meaningful Christian home decor—this printable poster brings the 95 Theses right into your space. Perfect for students, church leaders, or anyone drawn to the pivotal moments that shaped the faith. Download instantly and print at your own pace and size. Frame it, gift it, or use it as a conversation starter in your office, classroom, or prayer room 🙏
4571710979.alt_text: A printable poster featuring the 95 Theses by Martin Luther, designed for Christian home and office decor.
